description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeReportController class, which extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the preRender method to set up a component for employee time reports within the OrangeHRM time tracking plugin.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeReportController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling employee time report view and setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered by creating a new Component object with identifier 'employee-time-report' and setting it for the view.
